title: Astro Portal API v1 deletion of a space
description: DELETE /v1/space, and the request confirmed by e-mail that comes before it (POST /v1/space/deletion-request and its routes), from inside the application or from the web. See v1.md, section « Deleting a space ».

deletionRequest.description: The explicit confirmation of « Supprimer mon espace ».

deletionAccepted.description: 202: the erasure has begun and cannot be cancelled. Every session and every device of the space is detached at once; the erasure of the data completes by `completesBy`.

deleted.description: 401 of any call made afterwards with a credential of the deleted space. The application erases its copy of the space.

pendingDeletion.description: A request for the deletion of the space, waiting for the confirmation of its e-mail (the link or the code). Nothing is deleted while it waits. `sentTo` is the address of the space; `resendAt` when another message may be asked for.

requestBody.description: The body of POST /v1/space/deletion-request, optional: the language of the message and the time zone its end is written in.

requestAccepted.description: 202 of POST /v1/space/deletion-request: the request is recorded and its message leaves. A new request replaces the previous one, whose link and code stop working.

linkRequest.description: The body of POST /v1/space/deletion-request/link and …/keep, and of …/confirm from the page of the link: the token of the fragment.

codeRequest.description: The body of POST /v1/space/deletion-request/confirm from the application or the web, with the space's own credential: the six digits of the e-mail.

linkRead.description: 200 of POST /v1/space/deletion-request/link: what the page of the link shows before anything is done. The address is masked.

linkFragment.description: The fragment of the link of the message, `https://<service>/auth/delete#v=1&token=<token>&lang=<language>`, read as URL-encoded pairs. The fragment never reaches the service: a visit to the link (a mail scanner) sends nothing and consumes nothing.

deletionError.description: A refusal of the routes of the deletion request. `attemptsRemaining` comes with `deletion_code_incorrect`; `retryAt` (also `Retry-After`) with `deletion_request_rate_limited` and `deletion_request_unavailable`.
